agg_meta.pnode_policy: One representative pnode per bus: exact match first, then fewest buses sharing the substation, then lowest location id. 501 of 1,218 covered buses carry alternates; see bus_pnode.alternates.
agg_meta.peak_definition_hist: HE 8-23, Monday to Friday. NERC holidays not excluded.
agg_meta.fcst_calendar: study_day mapped to day-of-year within each run; months from a 365-day reference year.
agg_meta.duration_grain: 101 points, 0 to 100 percent of hours, richest first.
agg_meta.windows: solar = HE 10-16 (hours 9-15); wind = HE 1-7 and 19-24; flat = all hours.

constraints_rules.mcc_on|mcc_off: $/MWh — the bus's mean MCC in the binding hours / in every other hour
constraints_rules.assoc: $/MWh on the annual mean MCC: (mcc_on − mcc_off) × hours / year hours — an association
constraints_rules.contrib: $/MWh on the annual mean MCC: mean over the year of shadow × DFAX — exact (the run stores its MCC as −Σ shadow × DFAX; both are negated onto the settled sign)
constraints_rules.mcc: Every congestion figure is on ISO-NE's settlement convention, LMP = energy + congestion + loss: a negative congestion component prices the node below the system energy price (a generation pocket), a positive one is a premium over it. Settled rows are published as stored. Every PROBE run (5yr, 10yr, pcr2030/2035/2040) stores LMP = energy - congestion + loss, so its congestion is negated at read and its energy recomputed as LMP - congestion - loss; the PCR table's stored energy column (built the other way) is not read.
constraints_rules.dfax: the run's distribution factor of the bus's price node on the constraint
constraints_rules.hours: binding hours the bus has a price for (a real-time hour counts once however many five-minute intervals bound)
constraints_rules.system.*_abs_shadow: $/MWh by magnitude — interface limits are reported negative
constraints_rules.top.value: contrib where the bus is exact in that run, else assoc

study.case: one case held: a fixed injection at this bus on the PROBE 5-year run (2028 basis), headroom study of May 2026
study.rule: A size is tested only where the next larger one curtails, so a null share is "not tested", never 0. The share is curtailed MWh over the test profile's offered energy at that size.
study.not_carried: the 5_year_forecast_* statistic columns of the same table are column-shifted in the source (build_dims.py) and are not read

units.rule: Solar and wind units the PCR run places at this bus's price node. max_bid_mw is the hour's available output; max_bid_mw − dispatch_mw on a committed hour is energy the solve curtailed. Output offered while the run left the unit uncommitted (status U) is counted apart as uncommitted_mwh: the store does not say why a unit was left off (62 % of those solar hours price at or below $0). Existing and planned units in the run — not the plant a user is siting.
units.not_held: the 5yr and 10yr runs carry no unit-hourly table, so no unit curtailment is held for 2028 or the 10-year 2035 run

price.rule: Hours at or below $0/MWh — when a price-taking plant would curtail economically. A market signal, not a count of curtailed energy. Settled RT and DA by calendar year at the bus's settled price node; each solved run at the bus.

meta.cape_note: 5-year run input: 2,905 MW offshore wind on Cape Cod in 2028 (Commonwealth, Park City) — not in the ISO-NE queue for 2028; treat with caution
meta.sheet_2030_rule: The corrected sheet's lmp_2030 is the 5-year run (study year 2028) relabelled "5-Yr Ahead (2030)" (hist.All_Bus_Long_Forecast) and scaled by one uniform factor: sheet ÷ 5yr run = 1.0986 at the median of 2,415 buses.
